title: Passage 17
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: When a friend of yours turns to you to talk about his or her problems, you give advice and help.
sentences.cn: 当你的某一位朋友向你求助，倾诉他或她的问题时，你会给予建议和帮助。

sentences.en: One important thing of our growth is to make decisions to help our friends and learn to support each other.
sentences.cn: 我们成长过程中很重要的一件事就是做出帮助朋友的决定，并学会相互支持。

sentences.en: This requires us to learn what it means to help friends and how to help in the right way.
sentences.cn: 这就要求我们了解帮助朋友的意义，以及如何以正确的方式提供帮助。

sentences.en: This is just like a nurse giving proper care to the patients.
sentences.cn: 这就像护士为病人提供适当的护理一样。

sentences.en: The first step towards helping others is to identify that they need help.
sentences.cn: 关于帮助他人，第一步是确认他们需要帮助。

sentences.en: We all know that difficulties are part of our daily lives.
sentences.cn: 我们都知道，困难是我们日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: However, sometimes small things can lead to more serious problems.
sentences.cn: 不过，有时小事会导致更严重的问题。

sentences.en: If someone is crying, it's clear that they may not be well.
sentences.cn: 如果有人在哭，那很明显他们可能不太好。

sentences.en: Yet you may as well pick up small signs that your friends are not acting like themselves.
sentences.cn: 不过，你也不妨留意一些细微的迹象，看看朋友是否表现得不像平时的自己。

sentences.en: Maybe they're being bullied but shy about their problems.
sentences.cn: 也许他们正遭受欺凌，却羞于启齿。

sentences.en: Just remind them that you're there to help.
sentences.cn: 只需提醒他们，你随时愿意帮助他们。

sentences.en: They'll be glad if you give them a hug and ask what is going on.
sentences.cn: 如果你给他们一个拥抱并且询问他们发生了什么，他们会很感激。

sentences.en: The next step is to listen.
sentences.cn: 下一步是倾听。

sentences.en: Listening to others is very important throughout our life.
sentences.cn: 在我们的一生中，倾听他人是非常重要的。

sentences.en: We need to learn when to speak and when not to.
sentences.cn: 我们需要学习何时该说话，何时不该说话。

sentences.en: Just like any lady or gentleman would.
sentences.cn: 就像任何一位淑女或绅士那样。

sentences.en: As listeners, we should try to see things from their perspectives.
sentences.cn: 作为倾听者，我们应该试着从他们的角度看问题。

sentences.en: Listening is a sign of respect and an important skill.
sentences.cn: 倾听是尊重的表现，也是一项重要的技能。

sentences.en: Finally, when helping friends, consider practical support such as doing the chores for them or bringing them a plate of food.
sentences.cn: 最后，在帮助朋友时，可以考虑一些实际的支持行动，比如帮他们做些家务或给他们送上一盘食物。

sentences.en: Maintaining a positive manner and showing real joy in helping others can lead to deeper relationships and make you a better person.
sentences.cn: 保持积极的态度，并在帮助他人时表现出真正的快乐，这样可以建立更深层次的关系，并促使你成为一个更好的人。
